name: Thumbor Effects
description: Adds Thumbor smart-imaging effects to Drupal image styles.
project_description:
Thumbor is a smart imaging service. It enables on-demand crop, resizing, flipping and lots of filters. It features a very smart detection of important points in the image for better cropping and resizing, using state-of-the-art face and feature detection algorithms.

 Thumbor Effects is a Drupal module that allows you to create image styles with Thumbor effects.

 Read more about Thumbor.

 To allow cropping of images prepared by Thumbor check out the Thumbor Effects Crop module.

 The last version compatible with Drupal 8.7 and earlier is 8.x-1.8.
